attributes.text: There is nothing stronger than a woman that has rebuilt herself.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Girl boss – An ambitious woman determined to succeed in her business or career.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Be the leader you wished you had when you started.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: People respond well to those that are sure of what they want.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I am not lucky. Do you know what I am? I am smart, I am talented, I take advantage of the opportunities that come my way and I work really, really hard. Don’t call me lucky. Call me a badass.
attributes.author: Shonda Rhimes

attributes.text: Empower the women around you.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Sometimes the bravest and the most important thing you can do is to show up.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Try to live every day like Elle Woods after Warner told her she was not smart enough for law school.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: We are strong, we are made of fire! Do not fear the fire within.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: You passed every test you have faced, and you are still standing. Take this moment to marvel at how extraordinary that position is.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: We need to get women to the point where they aren’t apologizing. It is time to take ownership of our success.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: You can tell how much a woman loves her business by how much she relaxes on a Sunday.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: If there is any part of you instantly trying to make excuses or allowances or any sort of ‘reason’ why it’s outside of your control and things are just that way right now, then honey you are just gonna keep on learning that same lesson. Aka: don’t expect anything to change sister.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Behind every successful woman is herself.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Women like you don’t happen often. Never forget how rare you are.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Act like a lady, think like a boss.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Be the girl who decided to go for it.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Put your hair up in a bun, drink some coffee & handle it.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I’m not going to be the girl who didn’t pursue her dreams because she didn’t have money.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: A huge part in my growth has been in surrounding myself with other like-minded Boss Babes and people who understand the journey, find your tribe ladies.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Surround yourself only with people who are going to take you higher.
attributes.author: Oprah Winfrey

attributes.text: There’s room for all of us to win. if you don’t live by that, prepare to lose.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Be the kind of woman that other women want to up their game.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Focus on more than one stream of income. The average millionaire has seven.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: She has that girl boss hustle.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: If there’s one thing I’m willing to bet on, it’s myself.
attributes.author: Beyoncé

attributes.text: Have high standards and people will recognise you as a Boss Babe who doesn’t compromise.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: If you hang out with me I’m going to ask you what your life goals are every week.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Dear Self, Remember to slow down and enjoy the journey. You don’t have to constantly hustle to prove that you deserve this. The fact that you’re trying your best every day is proof enough, you’re enough. All of this will pay off and you’ll be grateful for everything. Love, Me
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: When life gives you lemons, you build a lemonade stand and profit.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Your small wins are just as important as your big wins. It’s because of those small wins like getting out of bed and showing up even when didn’t want to, that big wins are possible. Be grateful for every win.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I’m obsessed with becoming a better woman and getting my life together.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: If you leave your growth to chance, you are not going to make the progress you want.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: In whatever you do, you’re not going to stand out unless you think big and have ideas that are truly original. That comes from tapping into your own creativity, not obsessing over what everyone else is doing.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Act like you already have all the things you want.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: When Monday is your favourite day, you know you are winning.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Ready for that Monday slay.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Today, be responsible, open, pretty, honest, and most importantly, slay.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Let me adjust my crown and get my day started.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Women creating wealth, financial freedom and having an impact from what they love – That’s the sh*t I live for.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I may not be there yet. But I’m closer than I was yesterday.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Wake up, hustle, repeat.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Put your excuses to bed and get comfortable with being uncomfortable.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I got tired of my sh*t and started to form new habits, thoughts and behaviour that would take me to the next version of myself. Growing is one of the hardest things to do, but staying the same hurts more.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: The woman you are becoming is a piece of art, so be patient, it takes time to be a masterpiece.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I’m a woman of my word. If I’m going to say I will make it happen, best believe it. It is only a matter of when.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: You are getting better each, even if you can’t feel like it or can’t see it right away. Progress is Progress.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I succeed because I just don’t talk about making things happen. I actually go ahead and make them happen.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Deep down inside you know the truth. The truth is you can do this. If you would give it 100% you get 100%. The truth is, it is all up to you.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: I don’t even expect people to like me anymore. I’m in my own world.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Addicted to bettering myself.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: You know what’s different? Seeing a girl who intentionally decides her surroundings. Seeing a girl when to remove herself from a room and when to walk into one. She walks in power, close deals in heels.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Better to stay oops than what if.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Love yourself enough to set boundaries. Your time and energy are precious. You get to choose how you use it. You teach people how to treat you by deciding what you will and won’t accept.
attributes.author: Anna Taylor

attributes.text: Instead of letting your hardships and failures discourage or exhaust you, let them inspire you.
attributes.author: Michelle Obama

attributes.text: You create the world, blink by blink. It is entirely yours to discover and yours to create.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Harvard Business School professor Howard Stevenson famously defined 'entrepreneurship' as 'the pursuit of opportunity without regard to resources currently controlled.' I give a 'hell yes' to that definition — you should take that spirit with you to whatever job you’re doing or whatever project you’re undertaking.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: It doesn’t matter how many people do what you do. What matters is no one does it like you.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Be so committed to your dreams that you willing to endure discomfort, change and growth. Refuse to accept anything less than complete love and alignment.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: What you focus on will create more of it in your life.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Seriously, just faith it until you make it.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: It never gets easier. You get better.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: My bills used to give me chills. Now my checks give me respect.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: If you act the part and play the part, you will get the part.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: Her secret for success is that she did all things with passion.
attributes.author: Unknown

attributes.text: There’s no such thing as being committed to your goals while you’re still in your comfort zone.
attributes.author: Unknown
